summary: Jared Isaacman founded the payments company Shift4, which he led until 2025, and co-founded the air-combat training firm Draken International. A close Elon Musk associate, he bought and commanded two SpaceX private missions, including the first private spacewalk. Trump nominated him to run NASA in December 2024, withdrew the nomination in May 2025 amid his split with Musk, renominated him that November, and the Senate confirmed him in December 2025.
